events.label: c. AD 101
events.title: St Clement of Rome
events.summary: Apostolic Father traditionally associated with an early Roman witness to ordered ecclesial ministry.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Clement of Rome and Apostolic Ministry
events.study_topic: Clement of Rome and Apostolic Ministry

events.label: c. AD 107
events.title: St Ignatius of Antioch
events.summary: Early bishop and martyr whose letters are important witnesses to Eucharistic faith and ecclesial unity.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Ignatius of Antioch and the Catholic Church
events.study_topic: Ignatius of Antioch and the Catholic Church

events.label: c. AD 155
events.title: St Polycarp of Smyrna
events.summary: Apostolic Father and martyr associated with the generation after the Apostles.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Polycarp and the Apostolic Generation

events.label: c. AD 202
events.title: St Irenaeus of Lyons
events.summary: Early bishop and theologian known for defending apostolic continuity and the rule of faith.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Irenaeus, Polycarp and Apostolic Succession

events.label: AD 325
events.title: First Council of Nicaea
events.summary: Ecumenical council associated with the Nicene confession of the Son's true divinity.
events.source: VCS Study Topics: Ecumenical Councils; The Trinity

events.label: AD 373
events.title: St Athanasius
events.summary: Bishop and Doctor of the Church known for defending Nicene faith in Christ's divinity.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Trinity

events.label: AD 379
events.title: St Basil the Great
events.summary: Bishop and Doctor of the Church, one of the Cappadocian Fathers.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Trinity

events.label: AD 381
events.title: First Council of Constantinople
events.summary: Ecumenical council that reaffirmed Nicene faith and completed the Creed commonly called Nicene-Constantinopolitan.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Ecumenical Councils

events.label: AD 390
events.title: St Gregory Nazianzen
events.summary: Cappadocian Father and Doctor of the Church, often called the Theologian.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Trinity

events.label: AD 397
events.title: St Ambrose of Milan
events.summary: Bishop and Doctor of the Church whose preaching influenced Augustine.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Early Church and Fathers

events.label: AD 430
events.title: St Augustine of Hippo
events.summary: Bishop and Doctor of the Church, influential in theology, Scripture, grace, and canon discussion.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Councils of Rome, Hippo and Carthage and the Canon
events.study_topic: Councils of Rome, Hippo and Carthage and the Canon

events.label: AD 431
events.title: Council of Ephesus
events.summary: Ecumenical council associated with the confession of Mary as Theotokos, Mother of God.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Mary, Mother of God

events.label: AD 451
events.title: Council of Chalcedon
events.summary: Ecumenical council known for its definition concerning Christ's person and two natures.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Incarnation: True God and True Man
events.study_topic: The Incarnation: True God and True Man

events.label: AD 547
events.title: St Benedict of Nursia
events.summary: Founder associated with the Benedictine Rule and enduring Western monastic tradition.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Church

events.label: AD 604
events.title: St Gregory the Great
events.summary: Pope and Doctor of the Church remembered for pastoral, liturgical, and missionary leadership.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Papacy and Infallibility

events.label: c. AD 749
events.title: St John Damascene
events.summary: Doctor of the Church known for theological synthesis and defense of sacred images.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Sacred Images

events.label: AD 787
events.title: Second Council of Nicaea
events.summary: Ecumenical council associated with the veneration of holy images.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Sacred Images

events.label: AD 1215
events.title: Fourth Lateran Council
events.summary: Major ecumenical council that addressed doctrine, ecclesial reform, and sacramental discipline.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Eucharist / Holy Communion

events.label: AD 1221
events.title: St Dominic
events.summary: Founder associated with the Order of Preachers and preaching for the defense of the faith.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Church

events.label: AD 1226
events.title: St Francis of Assisi
events.summary: Founder of the Franciscan family and major witness to evangelical poverty and charity.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Church

events.label: AD 1274
events.title: St Thomas Aquinas
events.summary: Doctor of the Church whose theological work is central to Catholic intellectual tradition.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Eucharist / Holy Communion

events.label: AD 1380
events.title: St Catherine of Siena
events.summary: Mystic and Doctor of the Church known for service to the Church and papal exhortation.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Church

events.label: AD 1545
events.title: Council of Trent opens
events.summary: Ecumenical council whose decrees addressed reform, doctrine, sacraments, and the canon in the Reformation era.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Council of Trent and the Biblical Canon
events.study_topic: The Council of Trent and the Biblical Canon

events.label: AD 1552
events.title: St Francis Xavier
events.summary: Missionary and co-founder of the Society of Jesus, associated with Catholic missions in Asia.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Church

events.label: AD 1582
events.title: St Teresa of Ávila
events.summary: Reformer and Doctor of the Church known for spiritual teaching on prayer.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Christian Prayer

events.label: AD 1869
events.title: First Vatican Council opens
events.summary: Ecumenical council associated with teaching on faith, reason, and papal primacy.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Papacy and Infallibility

events.label: AD 1897
events.title: St Thérèse of Lisieux
events.summary: Doctor of the Church known for the Little Way of spiritual childhood and trust.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Christian Prayer

events.label: AD 1941
events.title: St Maximilian Kolbe
events.summary: Martyr of charity who gave his life for another prisoner at Auschwitz.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: Communion of Saints

events.label: AD 1962
events.title: Second Vatican Council opens
events.summary: Ecumenical council focused on renewal, the Church, liturgy, Scripture, and engagement with the modern world.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Church

events.label: AD 1997
events.title: St Teresa of Calcutta
events.summary: Founder of the Missionaries of Charity and witness to service of the poorest.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Church as the Body of Christ
events.study_topic: The Church as the Body of Christ

events.label: AD 2005
events.title: St John Paul II
events.summary: Pope whose pontificate included major catechetical, philosophical, and pastoral teaching.
events.source: VCS Study Topic: The Church
